## Summary

- What pet are you adding or updating?
- What category does it belong to?

## Checklist

- [ ] This pull request focuses on one pet only
- [ ] Folder name uses `pet-slug--author-slug`
- [ ] `pet.json` and `spritesheet.webp` are included together
- [ ] `pet.json` `id` matches the folder name
- [ ] `submission.json` is filled in
- [ ] A preview image is included
- [ ] Authorship is clear
- [ ] Licensing is clear
- [ ] `npm run previews` has been run if `spritesheet.webp` changed
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes
- [ ] No unrelated files are included
